query.text: 请帮我留意室外天气，出现冰雹或明显影响出行的天气变化时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please monitor the weather outside and alert me to hail or a clear weather change affecting travel.

annotation.text_zh: 玻璃屋顶有持续密集的敲击声，请留意天气，注意出行安全。
annotation.text_en: Persistent dense impacts are audible on the glass roof; monitor the weather and take care when going out.

annotation.text_zh: 现在可以看到室外有密集降水，请暂缓外出。
annotation.text_en: Heavy precipitation is now visible outdoors; consider postponing going outside.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
